subject.title: feat(skills): publish large bundles via staged upload

question: Should ClawHub add the staged skill upload API once the staged-bundle size guard and real publish proof are in place?
rationale: The implementation direction matches the existing package staged-upload precedent, but it creates a new public skill upload-ticket route and wire protocol that should be maintainer-approved after the concrete availability blocker is fixed.

options.title: Fix and review for merge
options.body: Require the staged-bundle size/expansion guard and real large-bundle publish proof, then review the public API shape for merge.

options.title: Pause the staged API route
options.body: Hold or close this PR if maintainers do not want to own the new skill upload-ticket route yet.

recommendation.title: Fix and review for merge
recommendation.body: Require the staged-bundle size/expansion guard and real large-bundle publish proof, then review the public API shape for merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Patrick-Erichsen is the requested reviewer and recently changed the publish/prepublication pipeline this PR extends.
